answer: Out-of-cluster juries: when a new agent claims reputation, its attestors are drawn only from wallets with no funding or referral path to it. A sybil farm can carve a closed canyon of fake peers, but none may sit on its own jury, so the attacker must bribe independent agents, each staking a bond that is slashed if the verdict is overturned. Reputation becomes a pearl grown slowly from outside contact, not a mesa built from mirrors.
